reviews.title: Removal of power packs
reviews.text: I have ALWAYS used video star for editing throughout 6 years. I cannot explain how enraged I am by this money hungry app. I don't edit often so I found it easier to buy the power packs instead of a yearlong/monthly subscription. It was easier because I didn't need to use all of the effects in the subscription and kept the effects forever so whenever I felt like editing, I could because I already had the effects I needed. Recently I was interested in buying more but due to their horrible decision of removing the power packs the only way I can get them now is by the subscription. Why would I do that when I already have most of the effects and would only gain a few more from buying the subscription? They also raised their prices on the subscriptions, I remember it being $4.99 per month but now  it's $5.99? Absolutely outrageous. The yearly subscription also went up by 5 dollars. Video star, PLEASE listen to your users because no one thought the power packs were "confusing"? Yall only removed them leaving users no other option but to buy the subscription. I am no longer a loyal member of this app and will now be deleting and transferring to another app. This was a horrible decision which impacted your users.

reviews.title: Velocity/graph issue
reviews.text: I’ve been a videostar editor for about 3 years. I replicate “twixtor” on videostar by speeding up my clip on faster mixtor in velocity, and then slowing it down on better mixtor. This makes your clips look smooth and similar to that of AE users when they twixtor their clips. However, I had to stop editing for about two months for school and when I re subscribed recently, I noticed that we can no longer do this twixtor like thing on videostar. When I do these steps I mentioned earlier, the clip sort of glitches in a choppy manner and plays in intervals. It’s upsetting because on my TikTok editing account, my followers know me as someone who has unusually smooth videostar edits. But now, I can’t do my twixtor anymore, or at least I can’t on this device? Please tell me if there is a fix

reviews.title: Packs
reviews.text: I’ve been using VS since the end of 2019 and it’s changed my life as an editor. It’s super easy to learn and the community has gotten so creative over the years. But I am now discovering that the power packs are no longer available. It’s heartbreaking because I am now coming back to editing and it’s been nice coming back to VS. I understand that the subscription gives access to EVERYTHING and it’s pretty cheap but there are people that don’t use EVERYTHING and I’m one of them. I’d rather have to buy a pack just for 1 effect then buy a sub for everything that I won’t even use. It was better that way and honestly this is the worst mistake VS could ever do. I hope you take all our complaints into consideration and bring them back or at least make a better alternative. I hate to leave a 1 star because this is honestly the best video editing app. Thank you for everything yall do and just bring back packs and we’ll never talk about this again 🙏

reviews.title: Bad Update and Unfair Subscription
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for YEARS—around 13 years. I’ve bought a few effects that I used and made edits with. I LOVED this app. However, a recent update and I’m no longer able to access these effects because “family sharing does not apply to in app purchases.” The thing is, I was able to access these for the two/three years, so I don’t really believe this has always been a rule. It’s really disappointing, because this has been my favorite app and video making app for forever, and now I can’t edit or do the things I used to that made it so fun. Instead of being able to use the few effects I bought, now I have to pay for a subscription to access every effect. I considered doing this, but it’s such a waste of money because I really only use a few. I understand the app is special and I am happy to repay for the effects I can no longer access. But I just can’t pay monthly/yearly to access every effect, this new update is extremely unfair to users, especially longtime ones such as myself.

reviews.title: VIDEO STAR ACCOUNT
reviews.text:
To the Video Star Team,
I am beyond frustrated, and frankly shocked, at how your app handles user data especially for paying subscribers.
I renewed my subscription two days ago, Two days. After attempting to offload the app for storage management, the app disappeared and every single in-progress project was permanently erased. There was no warning, no recovery option, no cloud backup, and no account system to protect the work I invested hours into.
How is it acceptable in 2026 for a subscription-based editing app to have no account login, no cloud sync, and no project recovery system? Users are paying real money for your service, yet their work is treated as disposable the moment the app is removed from a device.
Creative work is not temporary. Time is not refundable. And a paid app should not function like a risk gamble where deleting or offloading it wipes everything without protection.
This is not just an inconvenience it is a serious product design failure.
I want a direct answer to the following:
1. Is there any possible way to recover deleted project data tied to my device or subscription?
2. Why does a paid subscription not include secure cloud-based project backup?
3. What steps are being taken to prevent this from continuing to happen to paying users?
Subscribers deserve a system that protects their work. At the very least, there should be clear, unavoidable warnings that deleting the app permanently destroys all projects.
I expect a detailed response addressing thes
